headline: Bitcoin Long-Short Ratio Rises 0.51 To A 30-Day High Of 2.48
narrative: The Bitcoin long-short ratio rose 0.51 over the past day to 2.48, the high of its 30-day range. That positioning pipe is crowded long, at the 99.9 percentile, so leveraged money is stacked on the long side. Sellers firmly control the spot pipe, where 24-hour cumulative volume delta printed -619.737, and Bitcoin traded near 77k.
author: jordan
